query_text: An alcohol-free day tracker screen on my phone where I can see my current no-drink streak right at the top, plus a simple row of circles for each day this month that fills in when I mark a good day. I want to see my longest streak so far and my total dry days this year, and there should be a quick tap button to log today as alcohol-free without having to dig through anything.

Need a cold shower habit streak tracker for my phone that shows how many days in a row I have completed a cold shower, with a big clear number at the top so I can see my streak right away. I want to be able to tap once to mark today as done, see a row of past days in a simple checklist style, and get a small reminder if I forget to log before bedtime.

Make a 10,000 steps daily walking nudge screen for my phone that lists today's step count clearly at the top, shows how many steps I still need to hit the goal, and gives me a gentle push notification reminder in the afternoon if I am running behind. I also want a simple week view that shows which days I hit the target and which I missed, all on one screen without having to tap around.

Create a social connection habit reminder for my phone that helps me remember to call or check in with a friend or family member every few days. I want a simple checklist of the people I care about staying in touch with, a way to mark when I last reached out to each one, and a daily nudge so the habit stays on track. The streak counter should show how many days in a row I kept up the calling habit.

Create a journaling habit streak tracker for my phone where I can see how many days in a row I have written something, with an option to protect my streak once in a while if I miss a day unexpectedly. I want a clean list view showing this week and last week, a one-tap button to mark today as journaled, and a count of my total entries this month so I can see my consistency at a glance.

Build a 5K to marathon running plan builder for my phone that lays out each week of training in a simple list, showing what type of run I should do each day, how far, and at what effort level in plain words like easy or hard. I want to tap on any day to see the details for that session and mark it as done when I finish. The plan should adjust the upcoming weeks if I fall behind or skip a run.

Personal best milestone screen on my phone where all my running and workout records are listed in one place, sorted by type of activity, so I can quickly find my fastest 5K time or my heaviest lift. Each record should show the date I set it and how much I improved from the one before. When I beat a record it should feel like a small celebration on screen, not just a silent number update.

Create a workout buddy challenge leaderboard for my phone where I can see how my weekly activity compares to a few friends I have added. The list should show each person's name, their total workouts or active minutes this week, and a simple rank order. I want to be able to challenge a specific friend to match my step count or workout days for the week with a quick send button right on that same screen.

Build a heart rate zone workout intensity guide for my phone that explains each zone in plain everyday language, like easy pace, moderate effort, or really pushing hard, and shows which zone I should be in for different types of workouts. I want to enter my age to get my personal zone ranges and then see a list of suggested exercises for each level so I know exactly what kind of effort to aim for during my session.

Create a post-workout nutrition prompt for my phone that pops up after I log a workout and gives me a short checklist of things to eat or drink in the next hour. I want it to list a few simple options like protein, carbs, and water with checkboxes I can tap off as I go. The screen should also show how long ago I finished my workout so I know if I am still in the good window for refueling.

Create a mobility and stretching routine guide for my phone that lists each stretch or movement in order with a brief plain-language description of what body part it helps and how long to hold it. I want to be able to tap through the routine one step at a time with a simple timer for each move, and at the end see a summary of how many minutes I spent and which areas I covered that day.

Make a group fitness class schedule and booking screen for my phone that lists upcoming classes in a clear day-by-day layout with the class name, time, location, and how many spots are still open. I want to tap any class to see a short description and then tap again to book my spot or add it to my personal list of upcoming sessions. A simple reminder option for each booked class would be helpful too.

Wearable device sync and data import screen on my phone that shows a simple connection status for my fitness band or watch, a list of the last few synced sessions with date and activity type, and a one-tap button to pull in the latest data. I want to see clearly which information came from the wearable and when it was last updated so I know my records are current without having to guess.

Need a training block periodization planner for my phone that breaks my overall fitness plan into phases like building, pushing hard, and taking it easy to recover, shown as a simple list of weeks I can scroll through. Each phase should have a short note about the main goal and the general effort level for that period. I also want to mark which week I am currently in and see what comes next at a glance.

Make an injury rehabilitation exercise tracker for my phone that lists each recovery exercise in order with a plain note about which area it targets and how many times to do it. I want to check off each exercise as I finish it, log any pain level or notes for that day, and see a simple history of which days I completed the full routine versus the days I had to cut it short.

Build a basal body temperature chart for fertility tracking on my phone where I can quickly enter my temperature each morning and see a line graph of readings over the current cycle. I want the chart to highlight the shift that usually happens around ovulation with a clear marker, and also show a simple list of my logged temperatures below with the date and time I took each reading so everything is in one place.

Make a perimenopause symptom diary for my phone where I can log how I feel each day using a simple list of common symptoms like hot flashes, trouble sleeping, mood changes, and tiredness, with a quick tap to mark which ones happened. I also want a notes field for anything extra and a way to look back at past weeks in a tidy list so I can spot which symptoms are happening most often and share that with my doctor.

Build a dream journal with sleep phase notation for my phone where I can quickly jot down what I remember from a dream right after waking up, along with a simple note about what sleep phase I was likely in, like light sleep or deep sleep or just before waking. I want each entry to be dated automatically and listed in order so I can scroll back through past entries, and a simple tag for whether the dream felt calm, strange, or vivid.

Make a snoring and sleep apnea event marker for my phone where I can log each morning whether I or my partner noticed snoring or any breathing interruptions during the night. I want a simple list of dates with checkboxes for snoring yes or no, a notes field for anything unusual, and a way to see a weekly summary of how many nights had issues so I can track whether things are getting better or worse over time.

Jet lag recovery sleep schedule adjuster screen on my phone that helps me figure out the best times to sleep, wake up, and get light exposure after crossing time zones. I want to enter my home time zone, my destination, and my travel dates, and then see a simple day-by-day checklist for the first few days with suggested sleep windows and tips written in plain language rather than medical terms.

Need a sleep environment log for my phone where I can record the temperature, light level, and noise level in my bedroom each night before I go to sleep. I want a quick entry screen with simple sliders or choices for each factor and a notes field, then a list view of past nights so I can see whether nights with a cooler room or less noise actually led to better sleep quality the next morning.

Cycle symptom prediction and prep card screen on my phone that uses my past logged data to give me a heads-up a few days before my period starts, showing a simple card with what symptoms I typically get during this phase and a short checklist of things to have ready like pain relief or a heating pad. The card should update each day and feel like a friendly reminder rather than a medical chart.

Need a heavy day and flow intensity log for my phone where I can track how heavy my flow is each day of my period with a simple tap selection from light to very heavy, plus a quick note about any other things like clotting or cramping. I want to see a clear day-by-day breakdown for the current cycle and a comparison to last month so I can notice if anything is changing from one cycle to the next.

Need a period pain level and intervention tracker for my phone where I can log my cramp or pain level each day on a simple scale, note what I did to help like pain medicine, heat, or rest, and then see whether those things actually seemed to reduce the pain. I want a clean list of past cycle pain logs with dates so I can bring a real record to my doctor and show exactly what has been happening over the last few months.

Build a mood across cycle phase correlation chart for my phone that plots my daily mood ratings alongside where I am in my cycle so I can see if my emotions follow a pattern. I want to log my mood each day with a simple choice from a short list of options like happy, tired, anxious, or irritable, and then see a visual summary that groups those moods by cycle phase so the connection is easy to spot on one screen.
